extraction.notes: Three-month 2025 column only. Starting line is GAAP net loss attributable to common stockholders (-2,707). FFO subtotal recomputes to 5,215 and AFFO to 6,737 as printed. The AFFO non-controlling interest line is shown as '—' for the quarter and recorded as 0. BRT reports no core FFO. AFFO does not deduct recurring capex, so recurring capex was taken from the Capital Expenditures table on printed page 12 (quarter ended Sep 30, 2025): BRT share $1,411,000 (gross $1,550,000 less JV partner share $139,000), converted to thousands. Diluted shares 18,951,324 printed in full, divided by 1,000. Checks: 5,215/18,951 = $0.28 and 6,737/18,951 = $0.36, matching reported per-share figures.
